items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Maynard Ferguson has all of his teeth capped...the trumpet player that hits all the high notes.

ctx.x: What number reed are you using now?
Number three. Yeah. That Rico Royal is a very strong reed, it holds up. Yeah. It's got a nice sound to it.

Well, saxophone player, trumpet player, they always have this problem with their teeth so I had some work done on my lower mouth and it cost me twelve hundred. It was a lower bridge I had put in and then, more recently, I had a partial bridge put up in my upper part of my mouth. That cost thirty-one hundred. But, you know, through the years your mouth, your gums and your bone structure...all that pressure through the years, you know, it wears away and the bone structure wears away and then your gums recede.
